Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation with your procurement and finance teams, below is a pragmatic billing approach that should reduce upfront cash strain while keeping the pilot moving:

Proposal (summary)
- Month 1: 50% retainer invoiced Net30 (covers onboarding + dedicated capacity reservation)
- Months 2–3: two sprint invoices (30% / 20%) invoiced Net45 with consolidated monthly VAT line items
- Credit floor: conditional $150,000 credit buffer for the first 90 days (unlocked after signed PO + basic credit check)

If helpful, I can schedule a 30-minute alignment with your AP lead and our billing ops this week.
